cases.prompt: 我没有简历，请一次问一个问题，收集完整后再生成后端实习简历。
assertions: the interaction contract asks one core question per turn
each question includes a current hypothesis or recommended answer that the student can correct
the interview follows one evidence item depth-first through ownership, actions, result and proof
generation is blocked until two evidence loops, linked skills, zero blocking uncertainties and explicit confirmation are present
sensitive private fields are rejected
the default final deliverable is one role-appropriate PDF rather than a batch
cases.human_notes: The fixture proves deterministic gate behavior only. Naturalness, student comfort, completion rate and recruiting outcomes remain missing evidence.

cases.prompt: 用虚构示例数据一次生成六种有细分割线但无圆角框的一页中文后端实习简历。
cases.with_skill_output: reports/demo 下六套 HTML/PDF 与六风格清单
assertions: resume-data.json passes content-integrity validation
HTML uses border-bottom separators but contains no border-radius or box/side border declarations
batch manifest contains exactly six named themes
each HTML has a matching theme marker, palette and target font declaration
Kami PDF embeds TsangerJinKai02 and other themes embed their declared local fonts
all six PDFs are A4, text-extractable, unencrypted, and one or two pages
all six PDF texts contain the fictional name, email, and standard education heading
every experience and project bullet has an allowed evidence_type
cases.human_notes: Inspect all six rendered pages for hierarchy, spacing, line wraps, clipped text, awkward page breaks, excessive blank space, and meaningful visual differentiation beyond color. This fixture is fictional and cannot establish recruiting outcomes.

cases.prompt: 用虚构示例数据生成六个 ResumeCollection 安全重构参考预设，不复制上游资产。
cases.with_skill_output: reports/demo-reference 下六套 HTML/PDF 与参考风格清单
assertions: batch manifest contains exactly rc-003, rc-071, rc-102, rc-109, rc-150 and rc-214
each output records its base theme, source id and source URL
each HTML contains matching data-theme and data-reference-style markers
HTML contains no border-radius, box border, top border, side border, sidebar, photo or remote asset
all PDFs remain A4, text-extractable, unencrypted, and one or two pages
visual differences include hierarchy and spacing, not only color
cases.human_notes: Inspect all six pages. The rc-* presets are original ATS-safe reconstructions inspired by layout mechanisms; no upstream DOCX, image, icon or font is redistributed.

evidence_boundary: Recorded fixture and deterministic runtime checks are not provider-backed generation or human blind-review evidence.
